L1.name: SINGLE_DELIVERABLE
condition: One document or one clear deliverable
path: Write and read back the deliverable

L2.name: CROSS_FILE_OR_MULTI_SOURCE
path: Inspect only directly relevant authorities and dependents
Write each file once where possible
Read back all changed files together
L2.failure: If partial write/verification fails, mark PARTIAL, inspect actual state, repair only inconsistent items.

L3.name: HIGH_IMPACT_OR_IRREVERSIBLE
L3.failure: Any missing required authorization, impact or recovery item blocks the affected action.

preflight: Restate current-task objective, deliverable, constraints, non-goals and acceptance conditions internally.
Verify current branch/commit and target repository before changes.
Check docs/blueprint.json, capability registry, relevant SOP/problem IDs and existing responsibility before adding anything.
Compare sources by declared authority and freshness; archive history is not CURRENT.
If scope/authority/critical source is missing or conflicting, block the affected write/action or report UNKNOWN; do not silently assume.
change_policy: Reuse or extend an existing responsibility/ID before proposing a new one.
Do not create a parallel core, skeleton, enum, register or workflow with equivalent responsibility.
Capability/problem IDs remain stable; severity, status and title are independent fields.
Keep problem-register entries as concise problem statements; store remediation/experiments in their own authorized workspace, not in the problem register.
A candidate remains CANDIDATE until the predefined decision gate accepts it.
No formal blueprint change without explicit project-update authorization; otherwise create/revise only an authorized discussion/research record.
A title/path change is not evidence that an implementation or capability changed.

build_stage_flow.release_gate: 所有新增均指向既有責任或有明確新責任證據；關鍵接受條件可判定

build_stage_flow.scope: 只實作已通過規劃與授權的增量；先做 contract/unit tests，再接必要 adapter
build_stage_flow.required_artifacts: 程式／文件差異、契約測試結果、執行收據、錯誤出口
build_stage_flow.release_gate: 測試已實際執行、結果可回讀；授權拒絕與失敗路徑可觀察

build_stage_flow.scope: 核對跨檔依賴、來源／引用、狀態、封包、權限、回復、索引、變更記錄與退場風險
build_stage_flow.required_artifacts: 差異清冊、影響圖、回歸與恢復紀錄、已解／未解項
build_stage_flow.release_gate: 所有改動可追溯；沒有未解的重大死路或越權寫入

build_stage_flow.scope: 凍結版本後跑 TC／adapter tests、C0/C1/C2、A1–A4 及獨立確認集
build_stage_flow.required_artifacts: 測試總結、品質／成本／安全分報告、採納／否決決議
build_stage_flow.release_gate: 依預先固定的 rubric 與門檻決策；失敗與未知保留

mutation_protocol: Record baseline commit, exact target paths and approved action scope.
Build a change set before mutation; do not mix unrelated changes.
Prefer one atomic tree/commit for a dependent multi-file change.
After commit, read back changed file contents and inspect the recursive tree.
Parse all changed JSON; validate unique IDs, local references and expected path presence.
Run available tests for code changes. If not run, explicitly state NOT_EXECUTED; never infer PASS from file presence or successful commit.
On partial failure, inspect actual tree/commit state before retry; do not claim rollback removes external side effects.
Create trace/handoff records only where they provide a durable continuation or audit benefit.

assertions: Tool invocation success is not task acceptance.
A test file or planned case is not a test result.
Model self-review/rephrasing is not independent evidence.
Preserve conflicting sources and their scope; do not force a merge.
Unknown stays unknown until evidence changes its state.

routing_policy.rule: Select minimum path capable of meeting acceptance/safety; add depth only for material ambiguity, risk, conflict, dependency, failure or expected decision value.
stop_on: No new evidence or discriminating correction
routing_policy.fail_closed: Missing authorization or critical fields blocks the affected protected action; safely independent work may continue.

persistence.P2: State bundle/checkpoint for multi-stage or cross-session work

state_and_handoff.rule: GitHub is the durable handoff location; the handoff links to authorities rather than duplicating their full contents.

archive_policy.format: JSONL: one source file per line, exact UTF-8 content and source blob metadata
archive_policy.candidate_rule: Archived/history material is not automatically current; use current blueprint/registers for decisions.
archive_policy.binary_exception: The two original DOCX blobs are identified in the manifest but were not duplicated as binary by the text connector; original commit preserves them, paired Markdown is archived.

task_flow_applicability: INTAKE→AUTHORIZE→SELECT_SOP→PLAN→EXECUTE→VERIFY→PERSIST→REVIEW is a conditional task lifecycle, not a mandatory full path for every task. Apply only the steps required by task level and risk; mandatory safety, authorization, evidence and truthfulness gates are never skipped.

authority_resolution.conflicts: Use designated current authority. For implementation maturity, current code/status evidence outranks stale narrative; neither integration nor documentation implies tests passed.
authority_resolution.historical_links: Relative Markdown links embedded inside archived JSONL content are legacy source paths. Resolve via docs/index.json and the archive manifest.
authority_resolution.no_auto_promotion: Archived, candidate, research and manual-simulation material never becomes CURRENT solely because of newer file timestamps; require explicit decision and evidence.
